```{r setup}
library(terra) |> suppressWarnings()
library(sf) |> suppressWarnings()
library(here) |> suppressWarnings()
library(mapview)
mapviewOptions(basemaps = c("OpenStreetMap", "Esri.WorldImagery"))
# Load home made functions
devtools::load_all()

datafolder <- here("data", "raw-data", "nutzung")
outfolder <- here("data", "derived-data")

# The data was split per year using S01_prep_data.R
nutz_layer <- "nutz_XXXX.gpkg"
colNUTZ <- c("nutzungsidentifikator", "nutzung_fr", "id_cultu")

buffer_fields <- c(500, 1000) #in m

# get crop reference
ref <- read.csv(file.path(outfolder, "classes_rpg_nutzung_clc.csv"))
rmCat <- sort(unique(ref$name[ref$keep_ag == "0" & ref$source == "nutzung"]))

# get the coordinates from the points
# from shinyFunbiodiv/analysis/03_update_data.R
df <- read.csv(here(outfolder, "coordinates_year_crop.csv"))
# create an ID
df$ID <- paste(df$Study_ID, df$Plot_ID, df$Year, sep = "_")
# transform as spatial points
pts <- vect(df, geom = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
# project in EPSG 2056
pts <- project(pts, "EPSG:2056")

met <- read.csv(file.path(outfolder, "metrics.csv"))
met <- met[met$Study_ID == "PestiRed", ]

namean <- tapply(is.na(met$Perim_m), met$Plot_ID, mean)
# names(namean)[namean == 1]
# names(namean)[namean < 1 & namean > 0]
```

## Summary

There are two issues identified so far:  

- three points have no information on fields (```r names(namean)[namean == 1]```): they lay just outside the field edges (for 3.1 and 16.2) or the field is absent from nutzung (for 39.2).  

- ```r length(names(namean)[namean < 1 & namean > 0])``` points have no information for 2020 (from ID 71 to 89), Nutzung data is incomplete in this region for 2020.



## Coordinates outside the field


::: {.panel-tabset}

## 3.1

```{r}
i <- which(df$Plot_ID %in% c("3.1", "3.2") & df$Year == "2020")

# select point i
pti <- pts[i]

# create maximum buffer
buffi <- buffer(pti, max(buffer_fields))

# get rpg around buffer
nutzi <- vect(
  file.path(datafolder, gsub("XXXX", unique(pti$Year), nutz_layer)),
  ext = buffi
)

# checks
mapview::mapview(nutzi, layer.name = "Nutzung") +
  mapview::mapview(
    pti,
    zcol = "Plot_ID",
    layer.name = "coordinate"
  )
```

## Incomplete Nutzung for 2020

The issue with coordinates from ID 71 to 89 is only for the year 2020 when the Nutzung data is incomplete. As an exemple, we will show 71.1.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## 2020
```{r}
i <- which(df$Plot_ID == "71.1" & df$Year == "2020")

# select point i
pti <- pts[i]

# create maximum buffer
buffi <- buffer(pti, max(buffer_fields))

# get rpg around buffer
nutzi <- vect(
  file.path(datafolder, gsub("XXXX", pti$Year, nutz_layer)),
  ext = buffi
)

# checks
mapview::mapview(nutzi, layer.name = "Nutzung") +
  mapview::mapview(
    pti,
    color = "red",
    col.regions = "red",
    layer.name = "coordinate"
  )
```
